display_long_description:
# 🔍 REFLECT ON EXPERIENCES

Why do you keep repeating the same patterns? Dive deep into your daily life to uncover the roots behind your habits and emotions. Still wondering why you feel the way you do? Reflect. Customize. Find clarity. → Start with Eva — free

[media]

# 🧩 MAP YOUR PATTERNS

Untangle your complex thoughts and clearly map out the behavioral patterns driving your actions. 

 [media]

# 🧘 FIND LASTING PEACE

Turn your self-awareness into actionable steps to achieve true and lasting peace of mind.

[media]

EvaAI’s VR experience simulates the conversational flow of a therapy session, providing evidence-based stress-management techniques; this does not replace consultation with a licensed mental-health professional. EvaAI offers VR-facilitated coaching, not licensed therapy.
